round_history.retrieved_content:
[DAY1 17:33:02 - DAY1 17:33:29]
Tasha walks to the merchandise on my front-left and stops. I say, "I'll come along too." Tasha: "Buy eggs and get century eggs for free." We're choosing together. Tasha: "Perfect." I say, "Perfect timing." Alice: "Fresh eggs?" Tasha: "Yeah, fresh eggs are fine too." I raise my hand and point at the product in front and ask, "Is your home far from Gaoyou?" Tasha turns to me. Alice: "Gaoyou salted duck eggs." Tasha: "Not far." Alice: "Salted duck eggs." Tasha: "Your home isn't far either." I say, "Yeah, that's true."

[DAY1 17:32:30 - DAY1 17:32:59]
I watch Tasha scroll through her phone as she walks and talks. Tasha: "Eggs." Tasha: "Sugar and salt." Tasha: "Milk powder, coffee, whipped cream, mint, cling film." Tasha: "Tart crusts, strawberries." Tasha: "Why do we have to buy the paper too?" Tasha: "3-4 enoki mushrooms." I stop and look to the right. Tasha: "Century eggs, baby bok choy." Tasha: "Got it?" Tasha: "Let's go." I keep walking. "Baby bok choy, let's go," I say. Tasha: "Hey, eggs."

[DAY1 17:28:00 - DAY1 17:28:27]
Tasha says, "But this one is only 8.9 yuan." Lucia says, "I'm just guessing." I watch Alice load the drinks into the car. Alice says, "Juice—oh, they bought the juice." I stop the car again. Tasha asks, "Anything else?" Tasha says, "Milk, pasteurized eggs." Alice asks, "Did you buy the milk?" Tasha says, "Yeah, bought the milk." Alice asks, "Are two cartons enough?" Tasha says, "Should be enough." I push the car forward again. Alice says, "Pasteurized eggs." Tasha says, "Eggs, eggs." I asks, "Where's the heavy cream?" Tasha says, "Heavy cream is..." I asks, "Is it deep inside?" Alice says, "The cream should be near the yogurt—it's around the same area." I watch Tasha glance right and walk over. Tasha says, "I think it's probably in the freezer section."
